name: Les Cyclopes
source: ImageGen → Meshy 7.1 → Meshy remesh; original visor retained, straight sport beams and overlapping endpieces built in Blender from the author’s cycling reference
reference_role: Shape and funky palette only; no brand or product texture reproduced
modifications: Meshy mirror retains 1038 triangles, positions, UVs and corner normals. 16/18 mm approach retained. The upper frame receives a full overlapping endpiece; 8x4 mm visible beam stays level from frame to ear and outside the mohawk hair. Only the rear return descends, by 15 mm, following the scalp. Existing matte violet/citron atlas regions reused.
calibration: Real Quaternius CC0 iris samples and faceted heads; no reference body exported
mirror: View-dependent tinted studio MatCap in existing Painted Toon; no scene reflection
rights: Generated through the project’s Meshy account; Quaternius calibration references CC0. Product photo is reference only.
delivery: Workshop/iPhone pilot; not a published server inventory item
fit_validation: Frame/endpiece surface intersections on all four joins; zero rise in the visible beam; 36 profile/three-quarter visibility rays with male mohawk; zero ear/temple-skin intersections; iris and headband checks retained.
